description: This file defines classes, enums, and structures related to Android's SurfaceFlinger FrameTimeline, including SurfaceFrame, FrameTimeline, and associated metadata, used for tracking and tracing frame presentation, jank detection, and performance metrics within the graphics pipeline.

classes.name: TokenManager
classes.description: Interface for generating and retrieving prediction tokens associated with frame predictions.

classes.name: TraceCookieCounter
classes.description: Manages generation of trace cookies for perfetto tracing to correlate frame start and end events.

classes.name: SurfaceFrame
classes.description: Represents a single surface buffer or transaction, tracking timestamps, prediction, and presentation state.

classes.name: FrameTimeline
classes.description: Maintains a history of display frames, manages SurfaceFrames, and handles tracing and performance metrics.

classes.name: FrameTimeline::impl::DisplayFrame
classes.description: Internal class representing a grouped set of SurfaceFrames for a specific vsync, including timing and jank info.

methods.name: getCookieForTracing
methods.description: Generates a unique trace cookie for perfetto tracing.

methods.name: generateTokenForPredictions
methods.description: Creates a prediction token for a set of frame prediction timestamps.

methods.name: getPredictionsForToken
methods.description: Retrieves prediction data associated with a token if it hasn't expired.

methods.name: createSurfaceFrameForToken
methods.description: Creates a new SurfaceFrame with prediction data based on a token.

methods.name: addSurfaceFrame
methods.description: Adds a SurfaceFrame to the current display frame.

methods.name: setSfWakeUp
methods.description: Records SurfaceFlinger wake-up time and predictions for a frame.

methods.name: setSfPresent
methods.description: Finalizes the current display frame with present time and fences.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for debugging or configuration.

methods.name: setMaxDisplayFrames
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of display frames stored.

methods.name: computeFps
methods.description: Calculates the frames per second for specified layer IDs.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the FrameTimeline.

methods.name: onBootFinished
methods.description: Initializes perfetto tracing after system boot.
